Tyre reorder

Click a size for the full study. SET=hold 4 · PAIR=hold 2 · ord=buy to order · red=below floor.
SizeCatFloor/yrHand T1T2T3T4 Buy now
Buy = floor + this month's demand − stock, rounded to sellable units. Floors taper into year-end clearance (Jan T3/T4, Feb T1/T2).

Year clearance

Prior-year tyres must sell before the deadline. End of Jan (T3/T4), end of Feb (T1/T2).
In Q4, floors taper down and you buy only what sells by Dec 31 — for fast movers, taper in small next-year quantities so old stock clears first.

Understocked sizes

Sizes that hit zero stock during months they were still selling — the clearest sign of demand you couldn't serve. Estimated lost units = months out × average monthly demand. Click a size for its monthly chart.

Battery reorder

Batteries grouped by size — all brands of a size pooled. Per-quarter min/max reorder: pick a quarter, keep each size between its Min (default 1) and Max (peaks Q2–Q3). Click a size to see the brands and adjust.

Supplier orders

Your tyre buy plan for , grouped into a ready-to-send order per supplier. Each line is auto-sourced to the cheapest supplier that has the quantity in stock; use Swap supplier to choose another. Net price = list price after the supplier's discount. Built from the price/stock lists in your Stock files folder.
Sizes nobody lists appear under "Not in any supplier list" — source those elsewhere. Batteries and Apex aren't included here (different suppliers).

My changes

Every manual override you make is logged here — what the model predicted vs what you chose, and which month. Over time this shows where your judgement consistently differs from the prediction, so we can tune the forecast. You decide when to bake a correction in; nothing changes the model automatically.
